name: material-design-3-ui
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：material-design-3-ui。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Design, redesign, review, or implement user interfaces using Google Material Design 3 (M3), Material You, and optional Material 3 Expressive principles. Use for UI/UX screens, app flows, design systems, component selection, theming, responsive/adaptive layouts, accessibility audits, Figma-ready specifications, or developer handoff where Material Design 3 is required.
